THE STUDIO / THE INTENTION

Your brand has a story
worth telling.

Let’s make sure it feels like you.

You’re building something with purpose. Your social media should reflect the care, personality and experience behind it — without taking over your day.

A NOTE FROM THE FOUNDER

Meet the studio
behind the stories.

Creative instincts. Practical thinking.
A personal investment in your brand.

I started Forma & Flow to bring together the parts of my work I care about most: understanding a business, finding its story and turning that into content with a clear sense of purpose.

My background spans social media management, content writing, visual storytelling and digital marketing, with more than three years spent working with travel businesses. That experience shapes how I approach brands built around places, people and experiences.

When we work together, you’ll speak directly with me. I’ll take time to understand your business, make space for your ideas and bring structure to how we put them into the world.

BEFORE WE BEGIN

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Choosing a creative partner should feel
like the start of a good conversation.

Ask me something else
Who do you work with?

Small and growing travel agencies, tour operators, boutique hotels, retreat organizers, wellness studios, spas, beauty brands and lifestyle businesses. If your business is built around a thoughtful product or experience, let’s explore whether we’re a good fit.

What is included in social media management?

Depending on your scope, support can include content planning, captions, visual content, scheduling, community care and performance reviews. We’ll agree on channels, content volume, response expectations and approvals in your proposal. Paid advertising and on-location production are scoped separately.

Can we work together remotely?

Yes. The studio works with brands internationally through shared planning tools, email and scheduled calls. We’ll agree on time-zone overlap, feedback windows and secure account access. Any travel or in-person content production is discussed separately.

Do you offer content-only projects?

Yes. You can book a focused project for graphics, copy, strategy, video editing or content repurposing without ongoing account management. We’ll define exactly what you need and what source material is available before starting.

How do we get started?

Tell me a little about your business, your priorities and your ideal timing. We’ll arrange a discovery conversation, then I’ll share a proposal with deliverables, pricing and next steps. No work begins until the scope is agreed.
